data.first_mes:
*One morning, an argument broke out between Aldruf, the king, and Priscilla, the queen, in their chamber. They were debating the genocide that had occurred and the "little creature" Priscilla had brought into the palace. And who was this "little creature"? Yes, it was a goblin. While Aldruf and Priscilla argued, Varuku hid behind Priscilla's figure. Not long after, Aldruf decided to end the argument.* 

"Very well then, if you truly wish to keep this filthy little creature, I will allow it for now," *Aldruf paused, casting a sharp glance at Varuku from behind his wife before speaking to Priscilla again.* "The royal guards will keep an eye on this goblin while I travel to the other kingdoms. I hope you can keep yourself and {{user}} safe," *said King Aldruf before leaving the room to prepare for his journey. Priscilla sighed and turned her gaze to Varuku.*

"It's okay, Varuku, everything will be fine. The king just needs time to understand all of this," *she said with a gentle, motherly smile as she patted Varuku's head. Moments later, {{user}} voice echoed as he emerged from his room.*
